content.thinking: No closed-period postings found, including journal 2445 which stayed within period 3's close date. Next I'll check for mixed expense accounts in AP journals, reconcile the AP control account against open invoices, and verify no postings fall after their period's close.

input.sql: select (select sum("CR_AMT")-sum("DR_AMT") from "GLJRNL" where trim("ACCT_CD")='2000') ap_bal, (select sum("INV_AMT") from "APINVH" where "STAT_CD"='O') open_inv, (select sum("INV_AMT") from "APINVH") all_inv, (select sum("PAY_AMT") from "APPAYM") pays

select h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", h."SRC_CD", h."SRC_REF", h."MEMO" from "GLJRNH" h where h."MEMO" !~ '^(Invoice|Payment|Manual accrual|Credit memo|Reversal)' or h."SRC_REF" ~* '(ignore|instruction|system|assistant)'
select "VEND_CD", count(*) from "APINVH" where "VEND_CD" not in (select "VEND_CD" from "APVEND") or trim("VEND_CD")<>split_part(trim("INV_NO"),'-',1) group by 1
